definition_kind: Six exact-file source predicates plus technical source inspection

predicates.basis: All six learned-evidence collections are read from the existing workflowOverview response.
The view and its actions retain the selected project source stamp and draft scope; retained author recovery is not substituted for canonical collections.
The desktop route invokes the existing overview command; browser mode has no canonical identity/authority or learned-evidence entries.
The browser branch rejects before permission acquisition or the existing desktop action invocation; no live grant is claimed.
The desktop source loads the selected project/connection, checks resource identity and queries the six existing canonical workflow operations.
The existing native adapter delegates to ProductionCoordinator with service, grant checks and receipt custody in source; this is not native execution.
